# Civic Routes Copilot Instructions

## Project
This workspace contains Civic Routes, a MERN civic issue reporting platform.

## Stack
- Frontend: React, React Router DOM, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Axios, Socket.io client
- Backend: Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Mongoose, JWT, bcrypt.js, Socket.io

## Working rules
- Prefer concise, production-ready changes.
- Keep the UI modern, responsive, and animation-friendly.
- Preserve existing design language and avoid unrelated refactors.
- Use the current workspace root for all edits and commands.
- Update the README when setup or usage changes.

## Features in this repo
- Citizen signup/login
- Issue reporting with image, location, and category
- Admin dashboard for complaint status updates
- Community upvotes and comments
- Real-time issue updates

## Validation
- Verify code after edits.
- Fix lint or build issues before finishing.
- Create or update tasks only when they help the workflow.
